label: Built-up land (share of each ~1 km cell, Impact Observatory 10 m land cover) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
colormap: continuous red -> white -> green (red = low / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = high / increase); symmetric about 0, fixed across years
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
native_resolution: 10 m map, sampled at ~80 m, shown as class share per 0.01° (~1 km) cell
source: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m Annual Land Use Land Cover (io-lulc-annual-v02) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
basis: the annual Impact Observatory land-cover map itself (2018-2023; one map per year, no seasons).
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in percentage points/yr. Continuous colour: red = decrease, white = no change, green = increase (bilinear smoothing between cells; black hatching = data but too few years for a slope). No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
